claim: Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling creates and manages the CloudWatch alarms of a target tracking policy; in the AWS SQS walkthrough, creating the policy creates two alarms: one for scaling out and one for scaling in.

qualifiers.scope: per target tracking scaling policy (AWS SQS CLI example)

evidence.quote: This creates two alarms: one for scaling out and one for scaling in.
evidence.title: Configure scaling based on Amazon SQS

evidence.quote: Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling creates and manages the CloudWatch alarms that invoke scaling events when the metric deviates from the target.
